notes: 2026-08-31 BATCH 2, direction 2 (PROJECT_SUMMARY 5.14). Built on arm0_ctl and differing from it in window_mode ONLY, so the batch-1 control is still the control and no new control run is needed. The window is [span_lo, span_hi] x the CANDIDATE's own transition, so 'walk S* out of the window' stops existing rather than being penalised -- the complement of arm2_brack, which penalises it on a fixed window. SHAPE QUESTION ONLY: this declares the dose scale a nuisance, which is legitimate for radialization and wrong for fitting real data. Compare ONLY through fit.compare_arms, which re-scores every endpoint under arm0's objective: an arm minimising a window that moves with the candidate has cost values that are not comparable to anything, INCLUDING to its own values at other points. ARM 5: relative window WITH the anchor-validity guard. Predicts endpoints keep a real type-1 side (disp_max >= 0.95) and a locatable transition, and that contract C6 passes by construction rather than by penalty.
